decisions.reason: As the firm's current analytics plugin after the withdrawal of Universal Analytics, it is tightly tied to the core shop-technology and measurement offering, so management is likely to keep backing it and explain any modest results as temporary.

The retail system interface plugin uses the firm's integration capabilities and supports its full-service e-commerce positioning, so despite some risk from a narrower market fit, prior technical investment and responsibility make management more likely to continue than to exit.

Because the SEO workshops were launched only recently, publicly presented on their own page, and fit the firm's search-marketing expertise, management is likely to persist with them rather than withdraw them after a short trial.
